title: Histology: Muscle & Integument
description: Study notes for the Block 1.2 histology practicum: smooth, skeletal and cardiac muscle, the layers and cells of the skin, its sensory nerve endings and appendages (hair, glands, nails), and a slide-identification guide for the practicum.
